_about: ETHERION 공용 효과음 목록 (카드마다 다른 소리 말고, 게임 곳곳에서 나는 소리). build_sfx_prompts.js가 Gemini용 프롬프트로 펼친다. now = 지금 js/feel.js에서 이 자리에 나는 소리 이름(비어 있으면 새 자리 — 넣으려면 코드도 고친다). len = 소리 길이(초). music: true = 짧은 음악(승리 · 패배 등), takes = 세 테이크를 어떻게 다르게 할지(없으면 '조금씩 다르게').

items.desc: a crisp, satisfying click of a small brass switch set in dark wood, with a tiny soft low thump underneath; clean and immediate, not sharp

items.when: 단추 위에 커서가 올라갈 때 (아주 작게)
items.desc: an extremely soft, airy tick, like a fingertip brushing polished wood; barely there

items.when: 메뉴 · 상점 · 도감에서 카드를 누를 때
items.desc: a thick card lifted from a velvet tray: a soft papery snap and a faint warm glassy shimmer
the brass latch of a leather-bound deck case clicking open with a firm, tidy double click
a heavy parchment panel unfolding with a soft whoosh and a gentle low wooden knock
a parchment panel folding shut: a short reverse whoosh ending in a muted soft thud
a quick, light flick of a stiff paper tab, crisp and tidy
a small, precise metal toggle snapping into place with a clean click
a tiny, fine ratchet tick of a small brass dial

items.when: 룰북 · 매뉴얼 · 연대기의 책장을 넘길 때
items.desc: one heavy vellum page turning in an old book: a soft papery sweep and a gentle settle
a soft, clear glassy ping of a small crystal, gentle and short
two quick, dull knocks on an iron-banded wooden door, low and firm, clearly a refusal but never harsh
an ancient stone gate grinding open with a deep rumble, then a rush of shimmering ethereal air pouring through
a warm rising shimmer of crystal blooming into one soft, low resonant bell tone
a heavy cloth banner unfurling with a strong snap of fabric and a creak of its wooden pole
a sword drawn from its scabbard with a bright ringing scrape, followed by one deep, soft drum-like boom

items.when: 덱 조정실: 카드를 덱에 넣을 때
items.desc: a card slid neatly into a stack: a quick papery swish ending in a soft, crisp tap

items.when: 덱 조정실: 카드를 덱에서 뺄 때
items.desc: a card pulled out of a stack with a light whisk and a soft flutter

items.when: 덱이 정해진 장수로 꽉 찼을 때
items.desc: a satisfying heavy latch closing, followed by one warm glassy chime
a wax seal pressed firmly onto parchment: a soft squish and a solid stamp
a quill scratching one quick flourish across parchment
a thick deck of stiff cards riffle-shuffled and bridged: a fast ripple of cards and a final square tap
a thick card slid off the top of a deck: a quick papery swish ending in a crisp snap
several cards swept back into the deck with a broad papery whoosh, then new cards dealt in quick, soft snaps

items.when: 핸드에서 카드와 카드 사이를 넘나들 때
items.desc: a very soft brush of a card edge, light and silky
a card lifted with a firm, soft click and a faint airy lift
a card set back down with a soft leathery pat
a card peeled up off the table with a faint whoosh

items.when: 끌던 카드가 놓을 칸에 닿을 때
items.desc: a tiny magnetic tick, precise and soft

items.when: 놓을 수 없는 곳에서 카드가 제자리로 돌아갈 때
items.desc: a card sliding back into the hand with a soft reverse swish
a heavy card slammed onto a stone table: a deep soft thud with a crisp double latch click locking it in place
a face-down card set gently onto stone with a hushed, mysterious low whoosh and a faint tick
a card flipped over with a bright whoosh and a burst of tiny magical sparks
a card sliding across stone with a smooth scrape, ending in a soft click

items.when: 아이템 장착 (그 아이템의 소리가 아직 없을 때)
items.desc: a piece of gear fitted onto a fighter: a leather strap tightened and a metal buckle snapping shut
a card dissolving into a clear crystal: a rising glassy resonance and a sprinkle of tiny sparkles
a card catching fire: a quick whoosh of flame, crackling embers and ash drifting away
a soft rising shimmer, like light pouring into a glass vessel
a faint descending glassy drain, like light seeping out of a crystal
a fading crystal hum collapsing into a dry crackle of embers
a sword drawn with a ringing metallic scrape over a deep, soft swell; confident and clear
a heavy shield raised and braced: a solid wood-and-iron thud followed by a low resonant hum
a distant, muffled low drum hit with a soft airy tail; calm
two great iron-bound doors swinging open together: a deep boom with a long metallic ring-out
a coin slapped down onto the back of an armoured gauntlet with a bright ring
a sword struck flat against a shield with a decisive clang, then a bright rising metallic ring
a tower shield planted hard into the ground: a deep thud, a short chain rattle and a low steady ring

items.when: 준비 완료 단추 (멀리건 · 그 밖의 준비)
items.desc: a firm double knock on a wooden table followed by a crisp brass latch
a heavy coin flicked into the air: a sharp thumb flick and a fast spinning metallic whirr
a gold coin landing face up on stone: a bright, clear ring with a short shimmering decay
a coin landing flat with a dull, short thud and no ring
a soft ethereal whoosh gathering, then a coin flicked back up with a spinning ring
a coin spun on a metal shield: a metallic spin, then a glassy protective shimmer rising
a deep, heavy heartbeat thud with a crystal cracking sharply inside it
a warm rising glow, like a heartbeat steadying inside a crystal
two slow, deep, muffled heartbeats under a faint ominous hum
a thin stack of cards riffled slowly with a hollow, uneasy tick
a banner pole dropped onto stone with a hollow clatter and a soft cloth flop
a triumphant but warm flourish: rising strings, a golden French horn chord and sparkling harp, ending on a bright major chord
a melancholy phrase: low strings descend slowly, a soft horn sighs, ending on a hollow, quiet minor chord

groups.ko: 전투 — 공용 (카드 소리가 없을 때 · 능력 효과)

items.desc: a quick, clean whoosh of a body lunging forward

items.when: 일반 타격 (그 카드의 공격 소리가 아직 없을 때)
items.desc: a solid, punchy impact on armour and flesh: a tight thump with a short crack
a razor-sharp crack layered over a deep bass boom, with a short bright ring
a solid shield block: a firm clang with a bright ringing deflection
a fast whoosh passing close by and missing, with a faint airy flutter
a stone-and-glass card plaque cracking apart: a heavy crack, a crumbling break and debris scattering to both sides
a thorny bramble snapping back with a sharp sting and a rustle
an armoured fighter stepping in front: a heavy footstep and a shield slammed into place
a sharp thrust punching straight through a target and out the other side with a tearing whoosh
one strike leaping from target to target: three quick linked cracks, each a little lighter
an object hurled overhand: a spinning whoosh and a heavy thud on impact
a single sharp distant shot, a thin zip through the air and a precise, hard impact
a rune circle humming to life, a swirling rush of air and a creature landing with a soft thump
a spell snapped in half: a sharp glassy shatter followed by a reversed, collapsing whoosh
a quick snatching whoosh with a short rattle of chain
a rising, empowering surge of warm energy with a bright shimmer at the top
a sinking, draining sound, like light being pulled down into a dark hollow
a protective dome of glassy light forming with a smooth rising hum and a soft ring
a dome of glassy light cracking and shattering into tinkling fragments
a warm, soothing glow: soft shimmering light and a gentle, breath-like swell
a clear wave of water washing over, rinsing away a fading magical hum
a musket being reloaded: a ramrod scraping down the barrel and a firm flintlock click
a rising electric whine charging up, ending in a small crisp spark
a deep beastly huff and an earth-shaking stomp, with loose stones rattling
wood creaking and knitting back together with a soft rustle of new leaves

items.when: SPIN — 레버를 당겨 릴이 돌기 시작할 때
items.desc: a heavy brass lever pulled down with a solid clack, then mechanical reels whirring up to speed
a tiny, crisp ratchet tick of a brass pin flicking past
items.takes: three takes at slightly different pitches

items.desc: a firm mechanical stopper clunk followed by a short, bright ting
items.takes: three takes, each one a little higher in pitch than the last (one per reel)

items.when: 두 칸이 맞고 마지막 릴이 돌 때 (리치)
items.desc: a tense, rising shimmer over a quickening ratchet, building anticipation
a cheerful payout: a short cascade of coins into a metal tray with a bright sparkling chime
a big payout: a long waterfall of coins, ringing bells and rising sparkles

items.when: 세 진영 문장이 모두 다르게 — 카드 대박 (짧은 음악)
items.desc: a jackpot celebration: one bright orchestral hit with sparkling harp and bells over a flood of coins, ending in shimmering light
a soft, dull clunk and a gently deflating mechanical whir
water droplets falling onto a crystal: a clear drip, a tiny splash and a faint glassy ring
a crystal growing: a soft crystalline creak and a rising shimmer

items.when: 결정이 다 여물어 상금을 받을 때
items.desc: a crystal blooming to full size: a bright glassy bloom and a cascade of chiming sparkles

items.when: 라운드를 걸러 결정이 처음으로 돌아갈 때
items.desc: a small crystal crumbling softly into fine glittering dust
coins counted out onto a wooden counter, then a card slid across with a crisp snap
a card slid across a counter, then coins scooped into a leather pouch
a letter folded and sealed with wax, then sent off with a soft whoosh
two wax seals stamped one after another, then a bright clink of coins
one firm tap of a wooden gavel
three gavel taps, the last one ringing, with a soft jingle of coins
a heavy forge door creaking open with a warm roar of glowing coals

items.when: 재료 카드 셋이 하나로 모일 때
items.desc: three cards drawn together into a swirling vortex of light, spinning faster and faster
three hammer strikes on an anvil, each one ringing a little brighter, with sparks crackling
a radiant burst: a bright crystalline bloom, a resonant low bell and a card snapping into existence
a glass orb set into a brass socket with a click and a deep resonant hum
a heavy iron stamp pressed onto thick parchment with a solid thunk
a handful of crystal shards clinking into a leather pouch with a bright glassy jingle
a card materialising: a rising magical swell, a soft whoosh and a crisp paper snap
a cool blue shimmer rising, then one clear crystalline chime
a deep violet swell building, then a rich resonant bloom with sparkling tails
a golden surge: a rising shimmer, one deep resonant bell strike and glittering light
a mythic arrival: a deep sub-bass bloom, one great resonant bell and cascading shimmering light
a bright level-up moment: an ascending harp sweep and a warm, celebratory orchestral chord with sparkling bells
a smooth rising glassy fill, like liquid light climbing a tube
a quill ticking off a line on parchment, followed by a soft bright chime
a metal medal pinned on: a bright ring, a shimmer and a soft swell

items.when: 하루 첫 승 보상을 받을 때
items.desc: a treasure chest lid creaking open with a warm shimmer and a jingle of crystal shards
a large parchment map unrolled across a table with a broad, crackling rustle
two footsteps on a gravel road and the soft rustle of a travel cloak
an old iron gate creaking open on rusty hinges
a deep bronze bell struck once, its resonance fading slowly
an eerie wind through dark trees, distant creaking branches and a faint unsettling hum
a great bronze bell struck twice with warm, glowing resonance and a rising shimmer

items.when: 상대를 찾았을 때 · 방에 상대가 들어왔을 때
items.desc: a crystal ball humming to life, followed by one soft, clear bell tone
a soft wooden tick followed by a tiny glassy chime
three steady ticks of an old clock, the last one slightly louder
a heavy door closing far away with a muffled thud
